title: Protecting Children Online
paragraphs: Ketika putri sulungnya mendekati usia remaja dan meminta ponsel pintarnya sendiri, Ridwan berjuang menyeimbangkan kemandirian yang wajar dengan kekhawatiran nyata tentang risiko yang mungkin ia temui secara daring. Alih-alih menolak permintaan itu sepenuhnya atau memberikan akses tanpa batasan, ia meneliti alat kontrol orang tua dan melakukan percakapan jujur dengan putrinya tentang alasan spesifik di balik batasan apa pun yang akhirnya mereka sepakati bersama.

Putrinya awalnya menolak batasan tertentu, berargumen bahwa teman-teman sekelasnya tidak menghadapi batasan serupa, tapi Ridwan menjelaskan alasannya secara transparan alih-alih hanya memberlakukan aturan tanpa diskusi yang berarti. Setahun kemudian, setelah secara bertahap menyesuaikan batasan seiring kepercayaan berkembang melalui perilaku bertanggung jawab yang ditunjukkan, Ridwan meyakini pendekatan kolaboratif itu mengajarkan putrinya penilaian digital yang sesungguhnya, bukan sekadar menegakkan aturan sementara yang akan ditinggalkannya begitu tidak diawasi.
answerKey: As his eldest daughter approached her teenage years and requested her own smartphone, Ridwan struggled to balance reasonable independence against genuine concerns about the risks she might encounter online. Rather than either refusing the request entirely or granting unrestricted access, he researched parental control tools and had an honest conversation with his daughter about the specific reasoning behind whatever restrictions they ultimately agreed upon together. His daughter initially resisted certain limitations, arguing that classmates faced no similar restrictions, but Ridwan explained his reasoning transparently rather than simply imposing rules without meaningful discussion. A year later, having gradually adjusted the restrictions as trust developed through demonstrated responsible behavior, Ridwan believes the collaborative approach taught his daughter genuine digital judgment rather than simply enforcing temporary rules she would abandon once unsupervised.
